label: TARGET-ASSISTED per-image free-grid diagnostic on 8 train scenes; not validation, not a predictor

runner.optimizer: fresh Adam per scene, betas=(0.9,0.999), eps=1e-8, weight_decay=0
runner.sampling: all pixels at the existing working resolution; no augmentation

interpretation: A substantial display improvement demonstrates coefficient headroom on those scenes, not that the encoder can predict those coefficients from an unseen input.
An unsuccessful finite-budget fit is inconclusive about representation: optimiser and loss limitations remain. Do not declare an architectural ceiling from non-improvement.
Do not equate this target-assisted oracle with generalisation, recipe readiness, or pixel-perfect parity.
